scientific_integrity: The exact enumerator is proved by alternating-component decomposition and labeled enumeration. Separate breadth-first-search and component-recurrence programs crosscheck the results; neither program is used as an infinite-family proof.
scientific_limitations: The new claim is the complete sphere-count generating function and diametral multiplicities. The underlying one-flip model and distance formula are related to earlier geometric flip-distance work and are not claimed as discoveries. The result applies to odd triangular graphs, not their even-order counterparts. Independent scholarly review has not been performed.
title: Distance spheres of minimum dominating sets in odd triangular graphs
